description.body:
Story 1 of 6 of the REBUILD-MINIDON epic: the Accounts capability (L1-accounts), rebuilt in Rust. It covers 14 business rules and 19 requirements (registration, sign-in, profile), plus the platform and parity harness that every later story needs.

HOSTED PR STATUS: this is a local PR record. No hosted PR was opened. The agent raises the PR and never merges it (I-15). See hostedPr in pr.json for the repo facts.

Where to read, in order (paths are relative to the run folder .mw/runs/REBUILD-MINIDON/):
- ticket.md - the ask
- plan-onepager.md - the plan in plain words
- spec/spec.md - the spec (REQ-001 to REQ-019)
- adr/adr-001.md and adr/adr-002.md - decisions, threat model delta, and the human decisions in section 5 of adr-001
- test-plan.md - the planned tests
- repos/minidon-rust/plan.md - the per-file code plan
- build/wave-0-1.md, build/wave-2-3.md, build/wave-4-5.md, build/wave-6.md - the build logs
- reviews/plan-review-001.md - the plan review
- reviews/review-report-001.md - the independent code review
- coverage-delta.json - measured coverage on the changed code

Tests: 292 tests, 0 failed, across four layers: 97 unit, 139 integration, 44 parity, 12 compat.

Coverage: 97.9 percent of changed lines (1269 of 1296). Seven lines in non-main code are untested and listed in coverage-delta.json.

Parity against the Python app: 576 comparisons. 475 match exactly, 57 are 422 bodies matched by status and detail shape, 14 are whitelisted by decisions 1, 2 and 6, and 4 are documentation routes that are out of contract. The remaining 26 were unresolved and are decided in adr-001 decision 10 (U-01 to U-04 accepted as known differences). Each is pinned in the parity suite.

Independent review (reviews/review-report-001.md): verdict approve with findings. 0 critical, 1 major, 11 minor. The major, M-01 (the lone-surrogate deviation does not close a username oracle on sign-in), is accepted and not fixed in this story: adr-001 decision 11, with the threat model row 4 corrected. The 11 minor findings are left for a clean-up pass and are not blockers.

Human decisions: adr-001 section 5 lists decisions 1 to 11 (deviations, body limit, 422 shape, security sign-off, crates, Nix build environment, policy exceptions, parity differences, M-01). They are recorded as DEMO ASSUMPTION answers in the name of the decision owner (kurtis), except decision 8, which was a direct instruction. In a real team a Tech Lead and a security reviewer would decide.

SIZE WARNING: this PR is oversized. It changes 67 files with 13,645 insertions and no deletions (65 files and 11,814 lines without Cargo.lock and flake.lock), against the limit of 20 files and 500 lines in I-11. Story 1 absorbed the platform and parity harness work, so there is no smaller natural cut. Review it commit by commit: there are 28 commits, each built test first and each with one theme (skeleton, platform, accounts modules in dependency order, routes, parity harness, parity tests, compat tests).

The Python reference repo (minidon) is not changed (I-29).
